summary: This bill designates the U.S. Postal Service facility at 15422 NY 104 in Martville, New York, as the Sergeant Staret J. Engleston Memorial Post Office Building.

scores.thoughts: This bill merely renames an existing postal facility. It has no provisions that authorize, increase, decrease, or otherwise affect government expenditures.
The legislation contains no tax-related language, rates, credits, or revenue measures of any kind.
No provisions address healthcare policy, coverage, funding, or regulation.
The bill is silent on firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
No immigration, border, or visa provisions are present.
The bill does not address reproductive rights or abortion access.
While the honoree is a sergeant, the bill is only a naming measure and does not alter military spending, policy, or appropriations.
No environmental, climate, or regulatory provisions exist in the text.
The legislation does not modify any welfare, entitlement, or social safety-net programs.
No education funding, policy, or school-choice provisions are included.
The bill contains nothing related to drug enforcement, decriminalization, or substance policy.
No criminal-justice reforms, sentencing changes, or policing measures are present.
The text does not address tariffs, trade agreements, or globalization.
No deficit, debt-ceiling, or fiscal-policy language appears.
The bill does not engage with LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
No foreign-aid appropriations or policy changes are involved.
The legislation has no bearing on voting access, election integrity, or electoral procedures.
No technology, data-privacy, or regulatory provisions are present.
The bill does not address labor rights, union power, or workplace regulations.
No religious-liberty or anti-discrimination provisions are included.
